title: DSH Pet Manifest v2
description: Pet-center manifest v2 (issue #623). Pure-asset pet directory contract: renderer type declaration, license metadata, and renderer-specific blocks. Top level and renderer blocks are fail-closed; v1 manifests (no petManifestVersion) are compat-read as sprite2d by the registry.

id.description: Globally unique lowercase kebab-case pet id.

license.description: Asset license identifier (SPDX id or free text). Required so community pets always carry provenance.

homepage.description: Optional provenance URL for the pet assets.

renderer.description: Renderer kind; omitted means sprite2d (v1 compatibility). Unknown values are rejected.

sprite2d.description: Spritesheet renderer block; required when renderer=sprite2d.

spritesheetPath.description: Atlas path relative to the manifest directory (safe segments only).

cell.description: Atlas cell size in px; defaults to the Codex contract 192x208.

atlasRows.description: Total atlas rows; 9 for the classic contract, 11 for v2 look-row atlases.

frames.description: Per-row used frame counts; omitted rows fall back to the hatch-pet contract table.

tracks.description: Per-track rhythm overrides (durations/loop/fallback), v1 structure unchanged.

live2d.description: Live2D renderer block; required when renderer=live2d. The Cubism Core runtime is always user-supplied; the plugin never bundles or downloads it.

model.description: Path of the .model3.json relative to the manifest directory.

motions.description: ActivityPhase -> model motion group name. Unmapped phases fall back to the idle group; missing groups degrade to the first frame with a diagnostic.

expressions.description: Optional ActivityPhase -> expression name (layered over the motion).

hitAreas.description: Hit area names that trigger pet.interact; defaults to every HitArea the model declares.

blinkParts.description: Part ids that hold the eyes when the model has no usable eyelid rig. The renderer hides them for the blink moment (a hard cut, not a fade). Omit it and blinking relies on the standard ParamEyeLOpen/ParamEyeROpen pair, which does nothing for a model whose eyes are painted open.

expressionHold.description: Extra milliseconds an emotion expression stays on screen after its phase ended, per phase. The host owns how long a phase itself lasts, so this is how a cry can linger past the failure window.

blinkExpression.description: Expression the renderer applies for the blink moment. Use it when the model closes its eyes through ParamEyeLOpen/ParamEyeROpen only: an expression that overwrites them with 0 is the one parameter path that survives the engine's per-frame parameter restore.

skins.description: Optional selectable outfits. Each entry applies one expression the model declares (typically a parameter that swaps the drawn costume), so the choice costs no extra textures and keeps every motion/physics binding. Declare the default look first: no stored selection resolves to entry 0. The choice is persisted per pet.

label.description: UI-facing outfit name in the pet's panel.

expression.description: Name of an expression in the model3.json Expressions list; an undeclared name is dropped by the registry with a warning.

expressions.description: Per-phase emotion expressions composed WITH this outfit. The expression slot holds one expression at a time, so an outfit that must survive an emotion needs the outfit parameter baked into the emotion file.

frames2d.description: Frame-sequence renderer block; required when renderer=frames2d. Free-form named tracks laid out as <dir>/<track>/<frame>.(webp|png|gif|jpg|jpeg); phase-direct state selection (the live2d motions precedent). Frame durations resolve frameMs[i] > filename-encoded <base>_<index>_<ms> suffix > defaultFrameMs.

dir.description: Frame root directory relative to the manifest directory (safe segments only).

tracks.description: Named tracks (lowercase kebab ids, at most 32 chars).

items.description: Frame file name inside the track directory (no path segments).

frames.description: Explicit ordered frame list; omitted means list the track directory in filename order.

frameMs.description: Per-frame durations; requires an explicit frames list of the same length.

loop.description: false stops on the last frame, then enters fallback.

fallback.description: Track entered when a non-loop track ends; defaults to the idle-mapped track.

phases.description: ActivityPhase -> track name; idle is required, unmapped phases fall back to it.

skins.description: Optional selectable skins: each swaps the base idle target (idle phase, unmapped phases and every fallback back to idle) to its own looping idle track. Gameplay tracks (shy/work/sleep...) are not replaced.

idleTrack.description: A declared looping track that becomes the base idle while selected.

clickActions.description: Optional click-triggered actions exclusive to this skin: while selected, a tap rolls each action by probability (in order) and plays its track once if hit; misses fall through to the regular touch zones.

track.description: A declared track played once on hit (usually non-looping).

phrases.description: Optional lines spoken when the action fires.

gameplayTracks.description: Optional gameplay-state overrides: gameplay state name (e.g. 'sleep' or 'work') -> a declared frames2d track swapped in while this skin is selected (e.g. a skin variant of the sleep loop).

sequences.description: Renderer-agnostic ActivityPhase sequence table (v1 structure; every declared sequence has at least 5 items).

remarks.description: Per-slot witty-remark pools (v1 structure; a slot replaces the built-in pool for that slot only).

gameplay.description: Optional gameplay layer (frames2d pets only): stat decay, currencies, touch zones, work/sleep loops, passive income and a shop with optional lotteries. State references name frames2d tracks; structure is fail-closed in the validator.
